desc:
Welcome to Break For Soccer Cards! ⚽

🎁 Join The Group for a FREE Speed Card!

How to Play:
⛏️ Break Lucky Blocks to discover soccer cards!
💸 Place your cards on your plot and earn cash!
⚒️ Buy stronger pickaxes to break blocks faster!
🚀 Upgrade your conveyor and expand your base!
💎 Discover rare mutations and complete your index!
🔄 Rebirth for more mining power and cash!
🌟 Build your dream collection and show off your cards!

👍 Like the game to support more updates!
🚨 More cards, Lucky Blocks, and updates are coming soon!
